items.title: Qwen3-VL can scan two-hour videos and pinpoint nearly every detail
items.raw_content: A few months after launching Qwen3-VL, Alibaba has released a detailed technical report on the open multimodal model. The data shows the system excels at image-based math tasks and can analyze hours of video footage.
items.title_zh: Qwen3-VL 可扫描两小时视频并几乎捕捉所有细节
items.summary: Alibaba has released a detailed technical report on its open multimodal model Qwen3-VL, showing that it excels at image-based math tasks and can analyze hours of video footage.

items.summary: A pull request brings DWARF v5 debug information to OCaml's native compiler so that GDB and LLDB can offer source-level debugging.

items.title: Pebble Watch software is now open source
items.title_zh: Pebble Watch 软件现已开源
items.summary: Pebble Watch software is now 100% open source, according to an announcement that also covers Tick Talk #4 and PT2 demos.

items.title: APT Rust requirement raises questions
items.title_zh: APT 的 Rust 依赖要求引发疑问
items.summary: An LWN article examines the questions raised by APT's new Rust requirement, noting that it is rarely newsworthy when a project or package picks up a new dependency.

items.title: Paul Hegarty's updated CS193p SwiftUI course released by Stanford
items.title_zh: 斯坦福发布 Paul Hegarty 更新的 CS193p SwiftUI 课程
items.summary: Stanford posted video links and supporting material for the Spring 2025 version of CS193p, its course on developing iOS applications with SwiftUI. The sessions predate iOS 26 and Xcode 26, though the site says the code written during the course appears mostly compatible.

items.title: DRAM prices are spiking, but I don't trust the industry's why
items.title_zh: DRAM 价格飙升，但我不信业界给出的理由
items.summary: DRAM contract prices were 171.8% higher in the third quarter of 2025 than a year earlier, and mainstream DDR5 modules now cost at least twice their mid-2025 prices, with industry officials blaming AI data-center demand. The author points to the memory industry's history of price-fixing and urges skepticism about the stated causes.

items.title: Show HN: Real-time system that tracks how news spreads across 200k websites
items.title_zh: Show HN：追踪新闻如何在 20 万个网站上传播的实时系统
items.summary: A Show HN project monitors roughly 200,000 news RSS feeds in near real time and clusters related articles using Snowflake's Arctic embeddings and HNSW similarity search. Each story cluster shows who published first, how quickly it propagated, and how the narrative evolved.

items.title: GitLab discovers widespread NPM supply chain attack
items.title_zh: GitLab 发现大规模 NPM 供应链攻击
items.summary: GitLab says it discovered a widespread npm supply chain attack whose malware includes a "dead man's switch" that can harm user data.

items.title: The current state of the theory that GPL propagates to AI models
items.title_zh: GPL 是否传染至 AI 模型：理论现状
items.summary: The article revisits the debate sparked when GitHub Copilot launched in 2021 with training data that included large amounts of open-source code, and reviews the current state of the theory that the GPL propagates to AI models.

items.title: Credit report shows Meta keeping $27B off its books through advanced geometry
items.title_zh: 信用报告称 Meta 借助“高级几何学”将 270 亿美元移出账外
items.summary: A Hacker News submission, citing a credit report, claims that Meta is keeping $27 billion off its books through what the headline calls "advanced geometry."

items.title: The Math of Why You Can't Focus at Work
items.title_zh: 为什么你在工作中无法专注：一道数学题
items.summary: An essay argues that interruptions, recovery time and task size are the three numbers that determine whether real work gets done, with interactive visualizations showing the math behind bad days.

items.title: Garfield's proof of the Pythagorean Theorem
items.title_zh: 加菲尔德对勾股定理的证明
items.summary: The entry covers the proof of the Pythagorean theorem published by James A. Garfield in the New-England Journal of Education in 1876, while he was an Ohio congressman; it is listed as the 231st proof in a compendium of 370.

items.title: The CRDT Dictionary: A Field Guide to Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types
items.title_zh: CRDT 词典：无冲突复制数据类型的实地指南
items.summary: A field guide surveys conflict-free replicated data types from counters to sequences and explains the tradeoffs among them, written in the spirit of the Typeclassopedia.

items.title: Migrating Dillo from GitHub
items.title_zh: Dillo 从 GitHub 迁移
items.summary: The Dillo project is moving from GitHub to a self-hosted server with mirrors on other forges; the post recalls that the original dillo.org domain was lost in 2022 and later bought by someone who filled it with AI-generated ads.

items.title: “Boobs check” – Technique to verify if sites behind CDN are hosted in Iran
items.title_zh: “Boobs check”：判断 CDN 后网站是否托管在伊朗的技巧
items.summary: A social media post describes a technique dubbed “boobs check” for verifying whether websites behind a CDN are hosted in Iran.

items.title: Ask HN: Hearing aid wearers, what's hot?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：助听器用户现在都用什么？
items.summary: A longtime hearing aid wearer whose Phonak Audeo 90 failed after five years asks the community for current recommendations, citing needs in meetings, noisy environments and music listening.

items.title: TSMC Arizona outage saw fab halt, Apple wafers scrapped
items.title_zh: 台积电亚利桑那工厂停摆，苹果晶圆报废
items.summary: An outage halted production at TSMC's Arizona fab and led to Apple wafers being scrapped, according to an exclusive report saying the supply of industrial gases was interrupted when power at a vendor's facilities was cut.

items.title_zh: Unison 1.0 发布
items.summary: After years of engineering, design and community collaboration, the Unison team released version 1.0, which it says brings a refined programming workflow and a mature toolchain.

items.title: Show HN: Glasses to detect smart-glasses that have cameras
items.title_zh: Show HN：用一副眼镜探测带摄像头的智能眼镜
items.summary: A developer is building glasses that detect camera-equipped smart glasses such as Meta Ray-Bans, using IR retro-reflectivity from the camera sensor and wireless traffic, mainly BLE. An ESP32 consistently detects the glasses pairing and powering on, and less reliably when they leave the charging case; the project has stalled and the author is asking for ideas.
